latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill.
- Automatically checks for and applies updates to Clawdbot and all installed skills daily.
- Notifies the user with a summary report after each update.
- Configurable schedule and delivery options with easy cron integration.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and manual command references.
